thread.title: Amazon Shares Continue to Rally, Nearing Trillion Market Cap

author: Nina Lee
title: Amazon Shares Continue to Rally, Nearing Trillion Market Cap
text:
08/30/2018 65
Amazon.com Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) shares continued to rally into Thursday, breaking a new all-time high yet again. Shares opened higher, breaking the USD 2000.00 mark, paving the way for the Company’s to hit a Trillion Dollar market cap. On Thursday morning, Amazon’s market cap was approximately USD 986.29 Billion, just shy of the USD 1 Trillion market cap. Shares hit a new high shortly the opening bell of USD 2024.78.
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL) is currently the other Company to have surpassed the Trillion Dollar market cap, sitting at USD 1.08 Trillion. Amazon shares increased by 1.1% on Wednesday after Morgan Stanley analyst Brian Nowak reiterated his overweight rating and upgraded his price target to USD 2,500.00 per share.
Nowak said in his note to clients that he has confidence in Amazon due to its rapid growth and high margin revenue streams from its advertising, AWS and subscriptions, delivering higher profits. In the second quarter, Amazon reported an EPS of USD 5.07, more than double analysts’ estimates. Amazon Chief Financial Officer Brian Olsavsky said in the conference call that the Company’s cloud and advertising segments contributed largely.
For the third quarter, Amazon forecasts revenue to be between USD 54.0 Billion and USD 57.5 Billion or to grow 23% and 31% year over year. Operating income is expected to be between USD 1.4 Billion and USD 2.4 Billion. Analysts are forecasting operating income of USD 1.25 Billion on sales of USD 58.07 Billion. Amazon is approximately USD 50.00 per share or a 2.5% increase away from hitting the Trillion Dollar market cap, according to VentureBeat .
